thread:
eli: Quick sync — noticed a perf regression on the continuous batcher this morning. Batch utilization down ~22% and token/sec per GPU dropped. Anyone see a correlation with recent kernel-selection change?

maria: Yup saw the same. KV cache hit rate dropped ~12% around the kernel bump. That increased prefix misses so more short batches.

vikram: I ran a quick profile, posting the hot call stacks. Looks like we fall back to slower matmul for certain attention shapes after the kernel selector change.

jess: Can you paste the profile snippet? also we should surface this on the queueboard: batch_utilization, avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, kv_hitrate, kernel_variant_percent.

maria: profile:
```
# top 3 samples
attention_kernel_selector()  34%
matmul_fallback()            28%
kv_cache_lookup()            18%
```
Not great.

eli: Thanks. For observability, I want a short-lived dashboard tab that compares before/after: batch_utilization (1m/5m), avg_queue_depth, microbatch_count, tokens/sec per GPU, and kv_hitrate. Also an annotation for the kernel rollout time.

vikram: Agreed. Proposed PromQL for tokens/sec per GPU:
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (gpu_id)
```
For kv hit rate:
```
sum(kv_cache_hits_total) / sum(kv_cache_lookups_total)
```
We should sample microbatch sizes too.

jess: I'll add a Grafana panel layout: left column utilization + tokens/sec, middle queue depth + microbatch hist, right kv_hitrate + kernel_variant_share. Suggest a delta sparkline comparing 1h vs 24h.

eli: Also want an alert when avg batch_utilization < 60% for 5m AND tokens/sec drops > 10% vs 30m baseline. That should trigger paged SRE.

maria: One more datapoint: kvcache logs show a GC pause coincidentally at rollout time — small, but might spike misses. Posting sample log lines: `kvcache_eviction: scanned=1024 duration_ms=23`

vikram: If eviction increased misses, we might need to tweak token_budget target. Proposed: raise per-request token_budget from 128 to 160 for affected routes to allow longer coalescing window (trade latency tail). Thoughts?

jess: Let's A/B that. Add rollout flags so we can measure batch_utilization delta and end-to-end latency p95. Dashboard should show route-level split.

eli: Action items: (1) jess add the dashboard panels + rollout annotation, (2) vikram produce a short experiment plan for token_budget tweak + expected metric deltas, (3) maria audit KV cache GC settings and surface eviction rate metric, (4) I will add alert rule draft. I'll post links once done.

ci-bot: deploy job #5421 started for grafana/queueboard:ci -> staging

opsbot: FYI incident-2027-03: degraded batch_utilization observed 07:12-07:45, mitigated by kernel rollback at 07:47.

eli: Great — thanks everyone. Please keep updates in this thread when dashboards/queries are ready. :thumbsup:
